<script type="text/javascript">

        $(document).ready(function () {

            $('#txtUserName').attr('autocomplete', 'off');
            $('#txtPassword').attr('autocomplete', 'new-password');
            $('#txtPassword').val("");
            $('#txtUserName').val("");
            $("#txtUserName").focus();
            setFauxPlaceholder();
            var ismobile = (/android|webos|iphone|ipad|ipod|blackberry/i.test(navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase()));
            if (ismobile && 'false') {
                alert('You are currently accessing GoArmyEd via a Mobile Device. If you would you like to download the GoArmyEd Mobile App, please visit the App Store.');
            }
            $("#search-btn").removeClass("btn");
            $("#search-btn").addClass("btn2");
            $("#login_bttn").click(function () {
                $("#registered-users").toggleClass('display');
            })
            $("#login_logo").click(function () {
                $("#registered-users").toggleClass('display');
            })
            $("#login_menu_bttn").click(function () {
                $("#registered-users").toggleClass('display');
            })
            $("#create_acct").click(function () {
                $("#create_acct_hidden").toggleClass('display');
            })

            function keyDownTextField() {
                if ($('#badPWDMsg').is(':visible')) {
                    document.getElementById('badPWDMsg').style.display = "none";
                }
            };
            document.getElementById("txtUserName").addEventListener("keydown", keyDownTextField, false);
            document.getElementById("txtPassword").addEventListener("keydown", keyDownTextField, false);

            //ksparks - alert shown after 2 failed login attempts
            $("#warnLock").dialog({
                autoOpen: false,
                resizable: false,
                height: "auto",
                width: 500,
                modal: true
            });

            $('.closebtn').click(function () {
                $('#warnLock').dialog("close");
            });

            //09-25-18 ksparks - Used to fetch logos (6) after each carousel slide
            $.ajaxSetup({
                // Disable caching of AJAX responses - needed for IE
                cache: false
            });
            $j('#myCarouselLogo').carousel(); // initiate carousel

            //After carousel has slid - grab the active slide index and load 6 logos into the hidden set
            $j('#myCarouselLogo').on('slid.bs.carousel', function () {
                var idx = $j('#myCarouselLogo .item.active').index();
                var set = (idx == 0) ? "#set2" : "#set1";

                //querystring is just used to clear cache
                $j("#myCarouselLogo " + set + " .list-inline").load("/Ajax/Logo_Rotator.ashx?clr=" + new Date().getTime());
            });

        });

        function Login_Pressed() {
            return confirm("YOU ARE ACCESSING A U.S. GOVERNMENT (USG) INFORMATION SYSTEM (IS) THAT IS PROVIDED FOR USG-AUTHORIZED USE ONLY." + "\n" + "By using this IS (which includes any device attached to this IS), you consent to the following conditions:" + "\n" +
                        "The USG routinely intercepts and monitors communications on this IS for purposes including, but not limited to, penetration testing, COMSEC monitoring, network operations and defense, personnel misconduct (PM), law enforcement (LE), and counterintelligence (CI) investigations. At any time, the USG may inspect and seize data stored on this IS. Communications using, or data stored on, this IS are not private, are subject to routine monitoring, interception, and search, and may be disclosed or used for any USG authorized purpose. This IS includes security measures (e.g., authentication and access controls) to protect USG interests--not for your personal benefit or privacy. Notwithstanding the above, using this IS does not constitute consent to PM, LE or CI investigative searching or monitoring of the content of privileged communications, or work product, related to personal representation or services by attorneys, psychotherapists, or clergy, and their assistants. Such communications and work product are private and confidential. See User Agreement for details." + "\n" + "\n" + "By Selecting 'OK' you agree to the above conditions")
            ;
        }

        function showlogin() {

        }

        function setFauxPlaceholder() {
            if (!ElementSupportAttribute('input', 'placeholder')) {
                $("input[placeholder]").each(function () {
                    var $input = $(this);
                    $input.after('<input id="' + $input.attr('id') + '-faux" style="display:none;" type="text" value="' + $input.attr('placeholder') + '" />');
                    var $faux = $('#' + $input.attr('id') + '-faux');

                    $faux.show().attr('class', $input.attr('class')).attr('style', $input.attr('style'));
                    $input.hide();

                    $faux.focus(function () {
                        $faux.hide();
                        $input.show().focus();
                    });

                    $input.blur(function () {
                        if ($input.val() === '') {
                            $input.hide();
                            $faux.show();
                        }
                    });
                });
            }
        }

        function ElementSupportAttribute(elm, attr) {
            var test = document.createElement(elm);
            return attr in test;
        }

        function showOverlay(text) {
            var securePath = 'https://www.goarmyed.com';
            var enableChromeCAC = '0';
            var ua = window.navigator.userAgent;
            var msie = ua.indexOf("MSIE ");

            //IF using Internet Explorer or firefox, Allow CAC Login
            if (msie > 0 || !!navigator.userAgent.match(/Trident.*rv\:11\./) || enableChromeCAC == 1) {
                $("<div id='overlay'></div>").css({
                    "position": "fixed",
                    "top": 0,
                    "left": 0,
                    "width": "100%",
                    "height": "100%",
                    "background-color": "rgba(0,0,0,.5)",
                    "z-index": 10000,
                    "vertical-align": "middle",
                    "text-align": "center",
                    "color": "#fff",
                    "font-size": "75px",
                    "font-weight": "bold",
                    "cursor": "wait"
                }).appendTo("body");
                var i = 0;
                setInterval(function () {
                    $("#overlay").html("<div style=\"margin: 275px;\">" + text + Array((++i % 4) + 1).join(".") + "</div>");
                }, 300)

                location.href = securePath + '/CAC/CAC_login.aspx';
            }
            else {

            }
        }

        function closeOverlay() {
            $('#overlay').remove();
        };

        function BindEvents() {
            function keyDownTextField() {
                if ($('#badPWDMsg').is(':visible')) {
                    document.getElementById('badPWDMsg').style.display = "none";
                }
            };
            document.getElementById("txtUserName").addEventListener("keydown", keyDownTextField, false);
            document.getElementById("txtPassword").addEventListener("keydown", keyDownTextField, false);
        };

    </script>
